title: koofa hai aaj hashr ka manzar lie hue
body:
koofa hai aaj hashr ka manzar lie hue
phirte hai ek laash sitamgar lie hue
ghurbat me sar qalam kiya ibne aqeel ka
ab phir rahe hai laashae besar lie hu
<<DIVIDER>>
koofe ke dar pe farq ko latka dia hai jab
kyu phir rahe ho lash ko dar dar lie hue
tash'heer ho rahi hai ye bekas ke qatl ki
phirte hai laashe muslime bepar lie hue
<<DIVIDER>>
baaqar* adu ne laash se acha kiya sulook
galiyo me phir rahe hi sitamgar lie hue
